findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights to your work product pass to the client immediately upon creation rather than being conditioned on full payment.
findings.suggested_change: EHS and EHN shall obtain exclusive rights to intellectual property in the Products only upon full payment of all compensation and royalties due to Dr. Murray under this Agreement.

findings.explanation: Royalty payments are deferred for up to twelve months before being paid, which is significantly later than standard payment terms.
findings.suggested_change: Royalty payments shall be calculated and paid within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar month based on the Net Sales for such month.

findings.quoted_text: (c) Provide such other services related to the foregoing as EHS may reasonably request from time to time.
findings.explanation: You are required to perform open-ended additional services requested by the client without an explicit mechanism for extra compensation.
findings.suggested_change: Any additional services requested by EHS that are outside the agreed scope shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order and compensated at agreed hourly rates.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and look forward to moving forward. Before signing, I would like to propose a few minor adjustments: - In the relevant clause, intellectual property rights pass immediately rather than upon full payment, so I propose that these rights be obtained only upon full payment of all compensation and royalties due. - In the relevant clause concerning royalties, payments are deferred for up to twelve months, and I propose instead that they be calculated and paid within thirty days following the end of each calendar month. - In the relevant clause regarding additional services, the requirements are open-ended without explicit extra compensation, so I propose that any additional services outside the agreed scope be subject to a mutually agreed written change order and compensated at agreed rates. Thank you, and best regards.
